winwindow_constructor.reading: A plain memory object: vtable plus zeroed fields and one 0x18-byte child. No HWND is created here, so window creation must happen in Create/Activate.

sequence: on false: read the settings std::string and log
create_device.settings_layout_hint: The settings begin with an MSVC std::string (capacity at +0x18, data at +0, length at +0x10), followed by byte flags at +0x2A, +0x2B and +0x2F.

sequence: rcx = settings string data (the plugin name); edx = byte[settings+0x2F]
call 0x180197020            -> look up / load the renderer plugin by name
[this+0x58] = plugin object; if null -> failure log at 0x18030DE98
if false -> release plugin via 0x197120 and log
rcx = [0x180421428]          -> the Engine global already validated at runtime
call [engine_vtable+0x18]    -> register the device with the engine
device_creation_helper.reading: The renderer is loaded by NAME from the settings string, stored at this+0x58, initialised through its vtable slot 0 and then registered with the engine through engine slot 0x18.
device_creation_helper.cross_link: [0x180421428] is exactly the Engine global that was read live earlier (0x22ee236aeb0 at runtime, while the same RVA in Game.dll is code). The static creation path and the runtime sample therefore agree.
